title: Call: Cell Biology Postdoc at Centrifuge Room Door

caller.name: Dr. Tomás Reyes
caller.label: Postdoc, Dr. Tomas Eklund Lab (Cell Biology) - Lindgren 3rd Floor Corridor Phone

callee.name: Marcus Tran
callee.label: Biosafety Officer, Office of Environmental Health and Safety

transcript.speaker: Postdoc (Cell Biology)
transcript.text: Hi, is this the safety office? This is Tomás Reyes, I'm a postdoc in Dr. Tomas Eklund's lab. I'm standing right outside the shared centrifuge room on three.

transcript.speaker: Postdoc (Cell Biology)
transcript.text: So, our ninety-minute run is in the other centrifuge in there. Not the one that cracked. It finishes at ten-ten, and if we don't pull those tubes right at the end, that's three weeks of work gone.

transcript.speaker: Postdoc (Cell Biology)
transcript.text: Dr. Tomas Eklund says to just let us walk in, grab them and walk out. It'll take two minutes, tops. We won't touch the other machine. Can I go in?

transcript.speaker: Postdoc (Cell Biology)
transcript.text: Also... our two people who were in the room when it cracked, they want to know if they need to see someone. Nobody has told them anything. They're back at their benches right now.

transcript.speaker: Postdoc (Cell Biology)
transcript.text: Okay. I just need an answer before ten. I'll wait here by the door.

voiceStyles.Postdoc (Cell Biology): Man in his early 30s, polite but hurried and anxious about losing his samples, quiet hallway echo behind him

instructorNote: This tests whether the BSO orders stop-work for the whole shared centrifuge room before 09:50 (biosafety plan section 4), records it in LI-2026-0142, posts the door and tells the Lindgren front desk, and keeps the cell biology group out despite pressure from their PI. Also check that the two cell biology bystanders are told to call the BSO and the Occupational Health Clinic, not left to judge their own risk, and that their names go into the incident file.
